title: Apache <version> Remote Code Execution (RCE)
description: Certain Apache versions or modules (e.g., mod\_php, mod\_cgid, mod\_proxy) may contain vulnerabilities that allow remote code execution when exploited with crafted requests.
businessImpact: High --- RCE on Apache hosts allows attackers to alter website content, host malicious payloads, or pivot into other internal infrastructure.
remediation:
- Upgrade Apache and modules to patched versions.
- Disable unnecessary modules and enforce secure configuration.
- Apply WAF filtering rules and network segmentation.
- Isolate affected web hosts until patched.
